llm_justification.summary: A sharp move in the Netanyahu-out-by-2026 probability is a signal about Israeli political regime risk, best expressed through liquid Israeli proxies EIS (equity) and USD/ILS (FX). However, both the sign (risk-premium relief vs transition uncertainty) and the 12h magnitude are genuinely ambiguous given the long end-2026 horizon. Neither mapping clears the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a low-confidence, unclear-direction research note rather than a signal.
